_comment: Time-limited partner offers shown on eSIM pages. Each entry disappears on its own once `endsAt` has passed: pages read isEsimPromoLive() at build time and components/EsimPromoLine.tsx re-checks the reader's clock after load. Add an offer only after reading its terms on the partner's own site, and record where and when in `source` / `checkedAt`.

airalo-black-friday-2026.text: Airalo Black Friday: 25% off every Unlimited package with code BLACK25, until 30 Nov 2026.
airalo-black-friday-2026.appliesTo: All Airalo Unlimited packages (Japan Unlimited included)
